article.title: The Attention Economy Navigator, August 2026 w/ Akin Olla and Josh Elstro
article.author: Cayden Mak
article.content: This week we are building our Attention Economy Navigator for the month of August 2026. It’s our guide to what you should be paying more attention to, and what you can probably pay less attention to. And why those stories might not be what you’d assume. Joining to help build this month’s Attention Economy Navigator in real time are Managing Editor for Convergence, Akin Olla and Senior… Source
